title: Demurrage and Detention Free Time: cancelling a container record when its booking is cancelled
content:
## Scope

This policy of the AHL Demurrage and Detention Free Time category governs whether a per-container free-time record is cancelled when the booking it belongs to is cancelled.

## Policy clauses

1. A record is cancelled when its booking is cancelled while the record's free time is still running and no clock-stopping movement has been recorded.
2. The cancellation carries no charge.
3. Any product bought for the record stays charged, because bought products are not refundable.
4. A record whose container has already been picked up empty or discharged is never cancelled; its clocks run to their stop events and are invoiced under the invoicing rules.

When a record is cancelled, the cancellation date is recorded as its closing date.

## Stated cases

| Booking cancelled | Record status | Container already picked up empty or discharged | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | free time running, no clock-stopping movement recorded | no | Record cancelled, no charge; any bought product stays charged |
| yes | any | yes | Never cancelled; clocks run to their stop events and are invoiced |

## Points of judgement

**Q: A shipper bought AHL Free Time Extension 3 for an export container, then cancelled the booking before the container moved. Is the extension price returned?**
A: No. The record is cancelled without a cancellation charge, but the product bought stays charged because bought products are not refundable.

**Q: The empty was already picked up when the booking was cancelled. Is the record cancelled?**
A: No. Its clocks run to their stop events and the record is invoiced.
